architecture_contract.data_types: All 25 PTO ISA 0.58.0 TileDataType identities use deterministic PTO-v0 raw-carrier hooks; target numeric interpretation remains S5-T2.
architecture_contract.layouts: Row-major and column-major operands may be mixed; implementation-defined layout rejects before effects.
architecture_contract.locations: Vector, Matrix, Memory, and Any locations have identical PTO-v0 logical semantics.
architecture_contract.source_definedness: Every matrix, bias, scale, and explicit C source must have a defined valid region.
architecture_contract.preflight: All descriptor, type, layout, shape, source-definedness, destination, and explicit-C checks precede the first destination effect.
architecture_contract.aliases: Source-source aliases and D == C observe snapshotted pre-instruction sources; D == C is read-old/write-new.
